description: Docking of naltrexone (antagonist) and morphine (agonist) against OPRM1 (8EF5 crystal structure) to validate binding poses and measure relative affinities.
hash_method: eidos-canonicalization-v1 (excludes spec_hash and hash_method, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

kill_criterion.metric: RMSD to crystal pose for naltrexone/morphine

method: AutoDock Vina 1.2.5, box from crystal ligand, exhaustiveness 32
